Type: Town
First Visited: Not yet visited; the surrounding Reaches were the site of a @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} encounter

Description

The kingdom's northeastern trading hub: a relatively cosmopolitan port on the shores of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium}, at the border between the Kingdom of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}, the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers}, and the lake, whose vessels cross the Solvium in trade.
Built in sinking layers atop a thousand years of older cities — an old @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium}-era fort among them — that were razed during the fall of the Imperium.
The town was rebuilt and had been growing into its own before the stagnation set in; despite its trade it has not grown for years, locked in the same grand stagnation that grips the kingdom.
The old ruins are still visible beneath and around the current settlement — foundations too large for the buildings sitting on them, streets that lead to nothing, the outline of walls that once enclosed a much larger city, and scattered relics such as a drowned temple to the water gods.
The town sits within the Reaches, the marshy delta that separates it from the rest of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} kingdom and runs inland to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall}.

Name

Whether the name is possessive ("Haven's Reach" — named after a person called Haven) or plural ("Havens Reach" — the reach of many havens, referencing the multiple safe harbors along the shoreline) is a matter of local debate.
Nobody in the current era remembers the origin with certainty.
The Imperium-era name of the original settlement has been largely forgotten.

Notable Features

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s primary access point to trade on the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium}
  • Built on Imperium-era ruins; the old settlement was significantly larger
  • The town has been stagnant for centuries — never declining, never growing
  • Birthplace of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yMtETX400iieRRXN]{Paxton Lumnus}

The Reaches

Haven's Reach lies within @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.463cVY4T50jnwq7e]{the Reaches} — the marshy delta that separates the town from the rest of the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} kingdom and runs inland to the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall}, above which rise the failing spines of Hallowreach and Carnforth.
See @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.463cVY4T50jnwq7e]{The Reaches} for the marsh itself, its single road and bridges, and the drowned temple.

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tLfbM4E64pEL9VF9]{Solvium} — The great lake it sits upon, which the Reaches' trade ultimately reaches
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} — The river region to its north and east
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.PEnF3AXmLA3UEGGO]{Cragmarr} — The broken terrain connecting it to Beaconhold proper
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — The kingdom it belongs to
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.2oPdZNZmUGdavykO]{Bonewall} — The wall at the far end of the Reaches, whose spines Hallowreach and Carnforth rise above the marsh

Associated NPCs

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yMtETX400iieRRXN]{Paxton Lumnus} — Born here; passed back through the Reaches on his way to the wall, encountering Senna's barge

Events Here

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.SUWNsmWvbkJyVUMV]{Session 6} — In the Reaches below the town, Paxton came upon Senna's barge in the reeds, learned of her rebirth in Moldrex's vision, and burned the vessel to escape — killing Senna and unknown others hidden aboard
